summary: Hemant Sharma, an Assistant Project Manager at NexGen Tech Solutions, disputes a salary deduction following approved emergency leave. His manager Rakesh Malhotra explains the calculation based on company policy regarding Leave Without Pay (LOP) and performance incentives. Hemant subsequently invokes a specific policy clause for a Bonus Exception Request due to a medical emergency, resulting in the recovery of the withheld bonus.
